## Problem 1 - Tidyverse: New Zealand

### (a) Total Votes by Election Year and Voting Type

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

nzge <- readRDS("data/nzge.rds")
```

```{r}
vote_counts <- nzge %>%
  group_by(election_year, voting_type) %>%
  summarise(total_votes = sum(votes), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total_votes))

print(vote_counts, n = Inf)

```

\

### (b) Candidate Vote Proportions by Party in 2014

```{r}
candidate_votes_2014 <- nzge %>%
  filter(election_year == 2014, voting_type == "Candidate") %>%
  group_by(party) %>%
  summarise(total_votes = sum(votes), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(percent_vote = 100 * total_votes / sum(total_votes)) %>%
  arrange(desc(percent_vote)) %>%
  mutate(percent_vote = round(percent_vote, 2))

print(candidate_votes_2014, n = Inf)

```

\

### (c) Winning Parties by Election Year and Voting Type

```{r}
winning_parties <- nzge %>%
  group_by(election_year, voting_type, party) %>%
  summarise(total_votes = sum(votes), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(election_year, voting_type) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = total_votes, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(election_year, voting_type, party) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = voting_type, values_from = party) %>%
  arrange(election_year)

print(winning_parties, n = Inf)

```
